description: Before the tax year ends: every allowance they haven't used yet this tax year - ISA, Lifetime ISA, pension and carry-forward, Capital Gains Tax, dividends and each child's Junior ISA - with the pounds at stake, which kind (allowance lost, bonus lost, tax saved later, tax due), and the date to act by, biggest first, plus Marriage Allowance to check. From their own figures; the same lines as their Before 5 April Checklist. Use for 'what should I do before 5 April', 'what allowances haven't I used', 'what expires at the end of the tax year'.

band.description: Their income tax band, for the capital gains, dividend and pension relief figures. Defaults to basic, as the checklist does.

name: get_tax_year_end_check
title: Tax year-end check
